title: Oven Roasted Brazilian Sweet Potato Stew
description: A hearty and comforting lacto-vegetarian stew featuring Brazilian sweet potatoes and almond milk, served in a copper mug. This dish is perfect for a cozy night in.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, toss the sweet potatoes with olive oil, salt, black pepper, cumin, and paprika until they are evenly coated.
Spread the sweet potatoes in a single layer on a baking sheet and roast in the oven for 30 minutes.
While the sweet potatoes are roasting, heat the almond milk in a saucepan over medium heat until it is warm and steaming.
Add the kombu-cold-extract, onion, and garlic to the almond milk and stir to combine.
After the sweet potatoes have roasted for 30 minutes, remove them from the oven and add them to the saucepan with the almond milk mixture.
Stir the stew gently to combine and continue to heat it over medium heat for an additional 10 minutes.
Ladle the stew into copper mugs and serve hot.
Garnish with chopped fresh herbs, if desired.
